description: Eigenvalue-problem subclass. Six additional strict unitary pencil generators and the existing finite_cmv family with pencil coefficient outputs. Non-strict nonlinear problems remain documented separately. Public generators preserve [U,properties] and expose strict coefficients via terminal pencil mode. Two positive-metric symplectic-integration families are separately classified as circle_spectrum_only; their physical quotients need not be Euclidean unitary. Finite upper-Hessenberg projective pole pairs are now represented by a strict unitary--unitary generator and a separately classified general Hessenberg--unitary-Hessenberg nonunitary helper.
strict_pencil_criterion: B nonsingular, AA*=BB*, equivalently inv(B)A unitary in Euclidean inner product
